newsitem.title: HONG KONG: AsiaSat signs lease with Rebar of Taiwan.
newsitem.headline: AsiaSat signs lease with Rebar of Taiwan.

text.p: Asia Satellite Telecommunications Co Ltd unit said on Tuesday it had signed a five-year lease for satellite space with Rebar Tele-Communications Co Ltd of Taiwan.

AsiaSat said in a statement that Rebar leased 27 MHz of C-band capacity on AsiaSat 2, which will be used to distribute programming, including cartoons and sports, to cable television operators in Taiwan.
The parties also reached agreement for the use of a 9-MHz Ku-band transponder segment on AsiaSat 2 by Robar's satellite nes gathering operation, the statement said.

AsiaSat 2, a Lockheed Martin Series 7000 model, carries twenty 36 MHz and four 72 MHz C-band, as well as nine 54 MHz Ku-band transponders. Its C-band footprint covers 53 countries in Asia, the Middle East, Eastern Europe, Australia and part of the C.I.S. -- HONG KONG (852) 2843-6345
